phase_name: Refactor the test helper onto the production resolver

objectives.description: Re-read tests/_lean_check.py and each consuming module immediately before editing
Rewrite tests/_lean_check.py to delegate invocation/echo/resolution to semantic/checker.py, keeping every exported name
Keep the module-level probe in the test helper (skipif markers read SKIP_REASON at collection time)
Preserve the environment-absence versus protocol-failure split verbatim in behaviour
Run every consuming module with a checkout, and again with BIMODAL_LOGIC_PATH nonexistent, confirming clean skips

deviations.description: Rewrite tests/_lean_check.py to delegate invocation to semantic/checker.py
deviations.reason: run_check_certificate_with_sent now invokes the built check_certificate binary directly via semantic/checker.py's private _invoke helper (mirroring witness_constraints.py's existing precedent of importing certificate.py's leading-underscore window helpers across modules), rather than through `lake exe check_certificate`. This is a deliberate, documented consequence of F5 (measured ~50ms direct vs ~2.2s via lake) flowing through to the test differential tier as a speed side effect -- confirmed live: the three consuming modules' real-checker runs dropped from an expected ~2.2s/call to 0.01s-0.3s/call. Every exported name, signature, and skip/failure semantic is unchanged; only the subprocess command underneath differs.
